This filtered slice brings together a focused set of listings tied to Florida, with options that touch areas like education, STEM, community, medicine, arts, and other miscellaneous themes. You can compare programs for high school seniors, college students, and graduate students without jumping between unrelated results. Award amounts vary by listing, deadlines differ by program, and eligibility details can change from row to row, so it helps to read each summary closely before you apply. Many listings in this slice appear to have lighter requirements and often no essay, but you should still verify every detail on the official scholarship page.
